purpose: Real MCP A/B feasibility check: grouped vs spaced French semantic anchors, two stochastic takes per variant

parameters.style: Original dark acoustic Spanish indie, emotionally raw intimate vocal, dry rhythmic nylon guitar, tense low bass, restrained organic hand percussion, moderate forward momentum, lean live-room sound, memorable understated hook. Natural Spanish and French singing, no spoken intro, vocal starts within 3 seconds. Two French lyric lines belong to the same story. No cute, twee, cozy or bubbly pop, no boom-boom beat, no EDM.
parameters.note: Exactly the same style and generation controls for both variants. Variant title and French-line insertion points differ. Two songs generated per API request.

credits.note: 20 total credits observed across four generated songs; first unsupported negative_style request failed before generation.

api_limitations: negative_style on this Free plan returned feature_not_on_plan, despite controls.advanced being listed; use exclusions in style string instead.
Only v6-mini allowed through MCP; French/Spanish pronunciation still requires human listening and V6 comparison when available.
preliminary_findings: All four songs completed and have Suno song URLs.
Lyric alignments indicate three of four introductions start vocals at about 8.2–8.7 seconds, violating the 3-second target; only B replicate 2 begins at about 0.74 seconds.
A replicate 1 appears to lose the Spanish outro to the hard 60-second cap; remaining takes have the outro aligned, although B replicate 1 runs right up to the cap.
Automatic audio tagging identifies guitar/acoustic female-vocal arrangements, but cannot establish listener preference, French naturalness, exact words actually heard, or recall.
No conclusion about grouped vs spaced anchors can be drawn from only two stochastic takes per variant and no human listening.
next_actions: Human blind review of the four takes, especially whether all four target meanings are intelligible and whether French is natural.
Prepare a shorter 65–75-word lyric pack or revised structure to reduce hard-cut risk, then test a stronger first-vocal instruction or soft duration cap.
Do not spend further credits before extracting feedback from these four takes.
